Summary: This repo contains the code for the series of articles on 'Creating a Flight Tracking Dashboard'.
Description: MATLAB provides a large suite of visualization functions tailored to scientific and engineering applications. In addition, MATLAB enables you to develop domain-specific visualizations. These can be embedded in all data analytics workflows, ranging from small-scale interactive tasks to more complex reports, apps and web apps such as dashboard-like front ends. This toolbox contains the code and examples for the articles on 'Creating a Flight Tracking Dashboard', available under the MATLAB Graphics and App Building blog.
